== Original printed-face citation; relationship evidence scoped ==

The original scan has no printed Grabber icon. The Players Committee [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf 2023 Advanced Rulebook], Appendix A, p. 134, explicitly gives this card the [[Grabber]] icon. The retained icon field is therefore supported by later published rules; absence from the original face alone does not show that the field is invalid. Original printed art and later rules are distinct sources. Any reconciliation of the template, printing label, image and UID remains held; none was changed here. The Scomp reference is retained and supplemented with the [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183258/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Light.json preserved Players Committee Light.json] record 2802 / 2_41, whose pulledBy array contains the twelve existing relationship names. This is separate modern card-data evidence, not an archived Scomp page or original-face evidence. It does not verify the existing wiki link targets: the first plain Don't Do That Again relationship currently links to the Reflections III page, while the data distinguishes that plain relationship from the Defensive Shield relationship. The relationship prose and links remain unchanged for review. All game text, lore, stats, icons, identifiers, labels, printings and sibling pages are unchanged. Only the terminal newline was normalized to MediaWiki's preview output. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] 21:58, 6 November 2026 (UTC)
